args.subject: Child Seat Availability - Inquiry
args.body:
Dear New Car Rental Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to ask whether you have child seats available for rental.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether child seats are available with your vehicles
- The types of child seats you offer (e.g., infant, booster, toddler)
- Whether they are included in the rental price or available as an add-on
- Any age or weight requirements, and whether advance booking is recommended

Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
